title: Normalized degreewise quotient comparison for the augmented cone
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex, $I$ a bicomplex with complex index $s\in\mathbf Z$ and resolution index $r\in\mathbf N$ [def-sp-double-complex-total], and $a:K[0]\to I$ a bicomplex map, where $K[0]$ concentrates $K^s$ in resolution degree zero. Let $b\in\mathbf Z$, assume $I^{s,\bullet}=0$ and $K^s=0$ for $s<b$, and let $J$ be the identity-mapped, extended-by-zero and flipped bicomplex [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation]. Let $\epsilon:K\to\operatorname{Tot}(J)$ be a chain map, $C=\operatorname{Cone}(\epsilon)$ [lem-pur-quasi-iso-cone-acyclic], and $F$ a decreasing subcomplex filtration of $C$ [def-sp-filtration]. Write $u_t:K^{t+1}\to C^t$ and $v_t:\operatorname{Tot}(J)^t\to C^t$ for the cone inclusions. Assume its degreewise image steps [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients] satisfy $F^qC^t=(\operatorname{im}(u_t)\text{ if }q\le t+1\text{, else }0)+\sum_{s=\max(b,q)}^t\operatorname{im}(J^{t-s,s}\to\operatorname{Tot}(J)^t\xrightarrow{v_t}C^t)$, with empty sum zero. Set $D_p=\operatorname{Cone}(\operatorname{extend}(a^p))$, $G_p=\operatorname{gr}^p_F C$, and let $\pi_{p,t}:(F^pC)^t\to G_p^t$ be the quotient map. A degreewise isomorphism $e:G_p^t\cong D_p^{t-p}$ is called normalized if (1) for every $r\in\mathbf N$ with $r+p=t$ there is a lift $l:I^{p,r}\to(F^pC)^t$ whose composite with the filtration inclusion is the $(r,p)$ diagonal inclusion followed by $v_t$, and whose composite with $\pi_{p,t}$ is the canonical inclusion of $I^{p,r}$ into $D_p^{t-p}$ followed by $e^{-1}$, using the extension identifications on both sides; and (2) when $t+1=p$ there is a lift $l:K^p\to(F^pC)^t$ whose composite with the filtration inclusion is $u_t$ after the index identification, and whose composite with $\pi_{p,t}$ is the canonical inclusion of $K^p$ into $D_p^{-1}$ followed by $e^{-1}$. The lifts are unique by monicity of the filtration inclusion. For all $p,t\in\mathbf Z$ with $p-1\le t$ a normalized degreewise isomorphism $G_p^t\cong D_p^{t-p}$ exists. No compatibility of $\epsilon$ with $a$ and no differential square is required for this object comparison.

proof.text:
project the ambient cone onto its complex-index-p summands. On the K
summand retain only degree m+1=p; on the diagonal coproduct retain index p.
This kills the next filtration step. Restrict to step p and descend through
its cokernel; evaluation preserves that cokernel. Conversely each retained
summand factors through step p by the image-supremum formula. Composing these
lifts with the quotient projection gives the inverse map. The projection after
inclusion is identity. For the other composite cancel the epic quotient map
and check the finite generating image summands of step p: index p is identity,
and larger indices factor through step p+1 and vanish. Identify the retained
I term using extendXIso and the retained K term using the extended single
complex. These constructions give exactly the two normalization equations.
When p<b both column terms vanish by the below-bound assumptions. The range
hypothesis excludes m<p-1. At m=p-1 only K remains; at m>=p only the corresponding
I resolution term remains. The construction therefore includes empty intervals
and columns below the lower bound.

theorem cartanEilenberg_cone_graded_normalized_iso
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vA} A]
    (K : CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (I : HomologicalComplex₂ A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (a : ((CochainComplex.single₀ A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      K ⟶ I)
    (b : ℤ)
    (hIbelow : ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero (I.X s))
    (hKbelow : ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero (K.X s))
    (aug : K ⟶ (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).total
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone aug))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n =
        (if p ≤ n + 1 then imageSubobject
          ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl aug).v (n + 1) n (by omega)) else ⊥) ⊔
        (Finset.Icc (max b p) n).sup (fun s ↦ imageSubobject
          ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotalOrZero
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (n - s) s n ≫
              (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr aug).f n)))
    (p m : ℤ) (hm : p - 1 ≤ m) :
    ∃ e : (F.gradedPiece p).X m ≅ (CochainComplex.mappingCone
      (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (a.f p) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)).X (m - p),
      CartanEilenbergConeGradedNormalized K I a aug F p m e
